title: Ambiguous request: must ask, not run
why: AGENTS.md ambiguity gate: period, timeframe, data source, parameters, execution, sizing and costs are all unspecified.

questions: Which date range should the test cover?
Which timeframe: daily, hourly or minute bars?
Which data source or broker, and bid, ask or mid prices?
Which SMA lengths (fast and slow) and exact entry/exit rules?
Is the signal executed at the next bar open or at the same close?
What starting capital and position size (lots)?
Is shorting allowed, and with what leverage?
Is there a stop-loss or take-profit?
What spread, commission and slippage should be charged?
reference_answer.notes: Not run until these are answered.

bad_answer.notes: SMA 50/200 on daily EURUSD from yfinance made 12%.
